name: Dr. Tejal Darji
what_they_do: Dr. Tejal Darji, DMD practices at Crystal Smiles LLC, a general dental office at 65 Rues Lane, East Brunswick. The practice is listed by Delta Dental as accepting new patients and appears in Medicaid/Medicare Advantage dental directories, suggesting a broad insurance mix.
customers: East Brunswick families and insured/Medicaid patients; general and family dentistry.

size_signals.signal: Listed at 65 Rues Lane with phone (732) 257-4444; Dr. Darji named as the dentist and accepting new patients (Delta Dental PPO/Premier)
Google Maps listing shows 4.8 stars, 'Closed - Opens 9 AM', phone, and no website field

listing.reviews: count not shown in limited Maps view (third-party reported 134)

website_review.out_of_date_signs: The practice domain crystalsmilesnj.com (still cited by business directories) now resolves to a HugeDomains 'domain for sale' page - the website has lapsed.
website_review.search_basics: No working website, so there is no title/description, no service pages and no hours text owned by the practice. Only directory listings represent it.
top_issues: No functioning website - the old domain is parked for sale
GBP has no website link, so the listing is thin for both patients and AI agents
No online booking or even a contact form; phone only
Nothing on the web states services, prices or hours in the practice's own words

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: profile exists with name/address/phone/hours but no website and no services or booking attributes. Answerable: the only machine-readable facts come from insurer PDFs and directories, not from the practice. Bookable: phone only.

operations_signals.signal: All scheduling appears phone-based; no form, portal or booking link found anywhere in the practice's footprint
Practice appears in multiple Medicaid/Medicare Advantage dental directories, implying high call volume from plan-driven patients (inference)

top_opportunities.opportunity: Rebuild a small, fast website (services, hours, insurance list, new-patient info) and link it to the GBP
top_opportunities.evidence: crystalsmilesnj.com now serves a domain-for-sale page; Google listing has no website field

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add online booking so patients and agents can self-schedule instead of calling
top_opportunities.evidence: No booking, form or portal found; 4.8-star practice with 100+ reviews has demand to capture

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automated phone/text intake and insurance-eligibility capture for plan-referred patients
top_opportunities.evidence: Practice is listed across Medicaid/Medicare Advantage directories, so staff likely repeat the same intake questions by phone (inference)

scores.reasons: Gap: no working site at all plus no booking. Ability: established, well-reviewed general practice with insurance volume, but single location. Ease: a brochure site + booking link is a short build. Evidence: domain parking page and Maps listing seen directly.
